summary: The change makes the generic target policy prefer the root packageManager declaration and package lockfiles over deno.json, exposes the root package.json packageManager through the tree-facts resolver without adding any contents read, and updates the prospector-shaped tests. Prospector-style facts now resolve to bun with a `bun --no-env-file run check` verify spec, and the frozen-install precondition for any future local verify executor is recorded. No actionable defect was found.

evidence: src/host/target-policy-generic.ts:115-123 moves deno.json and deno.jsonc after the bun, npm, yarn and pnpm lockfile markers.
src/host/target-policy-generic.ts:135-141 reads the root packageManager match before marker detection, and line 279 passes facts.packageManager into detection.
src/host/target-tree-facts.ts:276-288 parses the already-read root package.json once and returns a string packageManager at line 333, adding no new contents read.

tests/host/targets_test.ts:358-429 and tests/host/target-policy-generic_test.ts:61-137 prove a tree with packageManager bun@1.3.3, deno.json and bun.lock selects bun with `bun --no-env-file run check`; the frozen-install precondition is documented at src/host/target-policy-generic.ts:273-274.
